for i from 0 while i is less than dword `02EBCBC0` (signed, re-read each pass) takes qword `p` = entry i of the qword table at `02EBCAC0` (stride 8) and, when `p` is non-null and `002E7600(p)` returns non-zero, calls the function at `003B76B0`+0x40 with (`p`, `ecx`); returns nothing
calls `003588B0(003590D0())`; then for i = 0 to 3 calls the function at `003E9190`+0x16 with `ecx` = i and, when it returns non-null, passes that pointer to `002E9FE0`; returns nothing

notes: Homing pack (callee-host). 0035AA50: the loop's first bound check is unsigned (jae) and the back-edge is signed (jl); both bounds are zero-extended words, so they agree. Calls to 0026DC40, 002E7A10 and 00263750 are cited by site because the page does not name them.
